name: Nasi lemak
description: Coconut rice with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and egg on a banana leaf.

tcm.note: Coconut rice with a hot sambal.

ayurveda.note: Ushna from the sambal; the rice is shita.

histamine.note: Dried anchovies, sambal and peanuts — the sides are what rate, not the rice.

nutrition.highlight: the sambal is what people argue about
